shell.notice: Results are for reference only and follow general standards. Real cases can differ greatly depending on the specific facts, so talk to a lawyer before making any decision.
shell.ctaTitle: Want to look at your own case more closely?
shell.ctaLead: Send us a message about your situation. A lawyer will review it and reply.

list.title: Calculators & Self-Checks
list.lead: Work out for yourself the things to check first in your case. Results are for reference only; for an accurate assessment, talk to a lawyer.
list.seoDescription: Simple tools to calculate and check for yourself the key points to look at first in a legal matter in Korea. Results are for reference only.

prosecution.title: Prosecution Request Estimator
prosecution.desc: Choose a crime and the circumstances to see the likely handling step and the sentence or fine the prosecutor may request.

sentencing.title: Sentence Estimator (Sentencing Guidelines)
sentencing.desc: Choose the crime, type and sentencing factors to see the recommended sentencing range and whether a suspended sentence is recommended under the 2026 Sentencing Guidelines.

drunk-driving.title: Drunk Driving Penalty Checker
drunk-driving.desc: Statutory penalties, license measures and disqualification periods by blood alcohol level, prior record and accident.

police-summons.title: Police Summons Checklist
police-summons.desc: What to prepare before you go, on the day of questioning and afterwards, step by step for your situation.

child-support.title: Child Support Calculator
child-support.desc: Standard child support and each parent's share under the 2021 Child Support Guidelines.

inheritance.title: Inheritance Share Calculator
inheritance.desc: Each heir's statutory share based on the order of heirs and the rule that a spouse receives 1.5 times a share.

reserved-share.title: Forced Heirship (Reserved Share) Calculator
reserved-share.desc: The base estate for the reserved share and each heir's reserved share amount, reflecting the 2024 Constitutional Court decision.

interest.title: Late Payment Interest Calculator
interest.desc: Interest by period and the total, at the statutory rate, the Litigation Promotion Act rate or an agreed rate.

court-fees.title: Court Costs Calculator
court-fees.desc: Stamp fees and service fees by the amount in dispute, type of case and level of court.

deadline.title: Legal Deadline Calculator
deadline.desc: Deadlines for appeals, immediate appeals, final appeals and more, calculated with public holidays taken into account.

interest-cap.title: Maximum Interest Rate Check
interest-cap.desc: Whether the interest on a loan exceeds the legal maximum rate (20% a year), and by how much.
